siteTitle: Damian Cyntler — Software Developer, programming and music enthusiast.
myHistoryContent: I have been working professionally as a developer since 2018, focusing on the Node.js ecosystem, particularly TypeScript and React. I build web applications, components and complex forms, and connect frontend interfaces with backend systems. I use AI models and agents to analyse code, plan work, implement solutions and test them.
whatDoContent: I like to understand software as a whole, from user needs and the initial concept to architecture and data flow. I am developing my skills towards a Full-Stack engineer role, with a focus on quality and usability. I am also interested in music, audio technology and music production.
